question: In which sport did Deepika Kumari earn her 12th individual World Cup medal at the 2025 Shanghai World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Archery**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Deepika Kumari** is a renowned **Indian archer** who has represented India in numerous international competitions, including the Olympics.
 
• She earned her **12th individual World Cup medal** at the **2025 Shanghai World Cup**, marking another milestone in her illustrious career.
 
• Deepika Kumari specializes in the **recurve category** of archery, which is the only discipline featured in the Olympics.
 
• The Shanghai World Cup is one of the prestigious events in the **World Archery Federation calendar**, drawing top-tier competitors from across the globe.
 
• Her achievements at the World Cup have cemented her position as one of the top archers in the world and a source of pride for India.
 
• Archery requires precision, strength, and focus, which Deepika Kumari has demonstrated consistently throughout her career.
 
• Winning a medal at the Shanghai World Cup involves competing against the best archers globally, showcasing her ability to excel in high-pressure environments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Deepika Kumari:**

 
 
• Deepika Kumari was born on **June 13, 1994**, in **Ranchi, Jharkhand**, India.
 
• She began her journey in archery at a young age and gained recognition after winning the **Cadet World Championship in 2009**.
 
• She has been awarded the prestigious **Arjuna Award** in **2012** and the **Padma Shri** in **2016** for her contributions to Indian sports.
 
 
 
• **Archery in India:**
 
 
• Archery has gained popularity in India over the years, with several athletes excelling at the international level.
 
• The **Archery Association of India** is the governing body responsible for promoting and managing archery in the country.
 
• India has produced world-class archers like **Atanu Das**, **Tarundeep Rai**, and **Deepika Kumari**, who have brought laurels to the nation.
 
 
 
• **About World Archery Federation:**
 
 
• The **World Archery Federation** (WA), founded in **1931**, governs international archery competitions.
 
• WA organizes events like the **World Archery Championships**, **World Cup**, and **Olympic Archery**.
 
• The World Cup series consists of various stages held in different countries, including the Shanghai World Cup.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Deepika Kumari’s Achievements:**

 
 
• Deepika Kumari has consistently ranked among the **top archers globally** and has won numerous medals across different competitions.
 
• She clinched the **gold medal** in the individual recurve event at the **2010 Commonwealth Games** in Delhi.
 
• In **2021**, she achieved the **World No. 1 ranking** in the recurve category.
 
 
 
• **Archery Disciplines:**
 
 
• The primary disciplines in archery are **recurve, compound, and traditional archery**.
 
• The **recurve bow** is used in the Olympics, whereas the compound bow is popular in non-Olympic archery tournaments.
 
 
 
• **Prominent Competitions:**
 
 
• The **World Archery Championships** is the most prestigious event organized by WA.
 
• The **World Cup series** includes multiple stages held across the globe, culminating in the **World Cup Final**.
